author: @BearBullTraders
raw_text: $SPCX could be 400% undervalued. If @elonmusk is right and $SPCX were to reach $500B to $1T in ARR, market cap could potentially reach $10T on the more explosive side. That implies a share price of $759/share, assuming 13.17 billion shares outstanding with no further dilution. A man that works as hard as he does, I don't see why not
notes: Musk の売上目標（2027年末に年率 $500B〜$1T）が実現した場合の株価 $759 を示し、「I don't see why not」と同意している。条件つきの楽観的なシナリオなので strength: weak。$759 は「explosive side」の上限側の試算。売上目標の期限（2027年末）は株価の期間として明示されていないので target_only。現在値の記載なし（「400% undervalued」から逆算はしない）
